programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Andre Pachon is the leader of the French chef community in Japan. Several of his apprentices have already appeared, but this time Pachon sends his number one man.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: The younger sibling of the Liang brothers, rulers of Cantonese cuisine in Japan, faces the Iron Chef Chinese.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Iron Chef Chen engages Challenger Lian Su Qin using konnyaku, a unique Japanese healthy food.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: The challenger is a woman who knows what she likes. As an elite culinary critic, she trained at Le Cordon Bleu and as well as Taillevent, an elite French restaurant in Paris.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: The former Iron Chef Michiba decides that Morimoto needs some help finding his feet, so he recruits his number one sous-chef from his own days at Kitchen Stadium.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Case of the Flue
programme.desc: In 1993, 82-year-old Kathryn Bishop was found dead in her Pennsylvania home. Tiny clues on the victim's body would tell police what happened that night.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Safe Place
programme.desc: A wealthy man and his wife were attacked by three masked men outside their luxurious Louisiana home. He was shot dead and she was forced to open their hidden safe. To solve the crime, police would have to find out who knew about the concealed safe.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Live Wire
programme.desc: A bomb, constructed to cause as much damage as possible, kills a victim with deadly force and flame. When a painstaking search yields some tiny clues, police are able to identify the killer as surely as if he'd signed them.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Van-ished
programme.desc: A twelve-year-old girl claimed she had been abducted and sexually assaulted. She recounted what happened in such a flat, unemotional voice that police found it difficult to believe her. Fibers on her clothing would prove she was telling the truth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Novel Idea
programme.desc: When the number and volume of bloodstains at the scene was greater than usual, it was up to forensic scientists to find out why.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Chief Suspect
programme.desc: The wife of a respected police officer was murdered in her own home. The crime went unsolved for more than a decade, until a newly formed cold case unit took a fresh look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Water Hazard
programme.desc: The victim had ingested a massive amount of cyanide. An unlikely clue ? a flaw on a mailing envelope ? exposed a murderer who was willing to kill innocent people.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shell Game
programme.desc: They thought the fire would cover their crime. But one tiny clue, no bigger than a thumbtack, remained. It held all the information investigators needed to put a trio of cold-blooded killers behind bars.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ring Him Up
programme.desc: In 1994, 19-year-old Shannon Melendi disappeared while at Emory University. Her disappearance remained a mystery for ten years, until new scientific testing cast a different light on Colvin "Butch" Hinton.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer Impression
programme.desc: In 1987, the death of Crystal Purcell was considered an accident. Then in 2001, Barbara Purcell called police to suggest that her estranged husband had killed Crystal.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder By Numbers
programme.desc: For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Federal Offense
programme.desc: When there's a difficult case to crack  whether it involves drugs, arson, or weapons  the investigators and scientists of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms have the means to crack it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Flames Of Justice
programme.desc: Arson fires are set for their own sake, or to cover a different crime, such as murder. Think fire consumes all vital clues? Think again. Arson investigators can glean important clues from scorched rubble and ignite the unquenchable flames of justice.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Pop Goes the Witness
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Willie McCarty is found at the base of a staircase. Neighbors direct Kenda to a truck spotted fleeing the scene, but a surprise visitor at CSPD turns the case on its head.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Rearview Mirror
programme.desc: When a retired military man runs over a pedestrian, it’s up to Lt. Joe Kenda to determine if it was bad brakes or bad intent.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Case That Haunts Me
programme.desc: As Det. Joe Kenda digs into another murder, he uncovers a world of violence and sexual fetishes, culminating in perhaps the most intense interrogation of his career.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Sex, Lies, and Surveillance Tape
programme.desc: A confrontation between enemies turns deadly, and Lt. Joe Kenda’s best hope for answers lies with a grainy, dubbed-over surveillance tape.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Fall From Grace
programme.desc: Hikers come across a horrific scene: the corpse of a man left nude, beaten and bound in the mountain wilderness.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Loose Cannon
programme.desc: In the dead of night, a shooter on a rampage rips through a home, leaving a grandmother disfigured, her 24 year old daughter dead, and a two year-old child clinging to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: There are many more worlds in our solar system than just the planets. The mysterious moons of the gas giants may hold much more than we ever imagined. Each one is unique, and each one deserves a scrutinous eye.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Belgian Collaborator
programme.desc: Leon Degrelle, a charismatic Belgian leader, joined the Nazis and led Die Wallonien on the Eastern Front. Despite no military background, he earned the Knight's Cross for valor. He recruited 4000 more for the SS, defending Berlin until April 1945.

programme.title: The Real Oppenheimer DA
programme.desc: I 1945 blev verden ført ind i atomalderen. Da hans rolle som bombens fader var blevet cementeret, blev Oppenheimer mere og mere bekymret over den potentielle fare, som videnskabelige opfindelser kunne udgøre for menneskeheden.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: They are iconic weapons: the Tommy Gun, Uzi, and today’s MP5. Invented to break WWI stalemates, the submachine gun revolutionized warfare and culture. Host Wil Willis explores its evolution, firing the Thompson and BAR.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Artillery, "The King of Battle," has shaped history from ancient cannons to today's M777 Howitzer. Host Wil Willis visits Fort Sill, Oklahoma, to witness modern artillery like the M777 and M109 Paladin in action.

programme.title: Awkward: Girls Gone Viral

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting

programme.desc: For at blive noteret for en fritidsaktivitet melder Chris sig til at skrive på skoleavisen.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader transportmyndighederne

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader det første kys

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi fortæller om, hvordan det er, når vi skal finde en kvinde på gaden, som vi kan gøre gravid. Det er en vild, sjov og skør opgave. Vi har også en medvirkende, der virkelig er presset over hendes opgave og så én, der ikke fatter, hvad der ramte ham.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: En ellers lidt ordinær video EKSPLODEREDE på Tik Tok, da en mand der hjalp sagde nej til Pelles blomster med ordene ”Nej tak, jeg er til kvinder – helst!”. Vi taler om, hvad der har overrasket os i forhold til hvilke videoer der når langt ud.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Hvad gør folk, hvis de får valget mellem at beholde en stor gave selv og give en lille en videre – eller omvendt!? Det ser vi på i de her videoer, hvor vi netop leger med at give dem, der hjælper, den mulighed. Det er overraskende, hvad der sker.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Hvordan går det, når vi har allieret os med TV-værten Anders Breinholt? – det bliver lidt noget rod, og senere, så ender vi i et kæmpe dilemma, når der pludselig er flere, der springer til for at hjælpe – og vi har kun én præmie.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 501
programme.desc: For første gang i Skønne ombygninger rejser fyrene til udlandet, nemlig ned til de franske vinstokke. Her renoverer de et charmerende sommerhus for et norsk par, i hjertet af Provence.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 502
programme.desc: I andet afsnit af sæsonen rejser vores renoveringsgenier til en hytte uden for den idylliske by Lillesand. Det bliver en uforglemmelig uge med et kreativt og overraskende resultat.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 503
programme.desc: Teamet har aldrig før haft at gøre med en uidentificerbar flyvende genstand, men én gang skal jo være den første. Hold på hat og briller, for deres projekt i Nevlunghavn bliver en udenjordisk oplevelse.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 504
programme.desc: Denne uge påbegynder teamet en renovering, som ejerne ikke har efterspurgt. De tilbringer seks dage ved Værøy fyr uden for Lofoten på en opgave, som ejerne tror vil tage fem til seks år.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 505
programme.desc: En gammel bjælkehytte på en ø midt i Nordmarka får en større opgradering og bliver tilpasset nye tider.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: De 19 bedste deltagere dyster i to klassikere: ‘kokken og eleverne’ og en stafet. Kun ét hold går videre, resten ryger ud over to elimineringsdage.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: Duftene eksploderer i køkkenet, deltagerne bliver udfordret i det indiske køkken. I dagens første konkurrence står én af de store indiske klassikere på menuen, og det bliver ikke for de chili-kræsne.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: Konichiwa! I dagens konkurrence går turen til Japan, hvor der er fokus på enkelhed og dybe smage. Det bliver ikke nemt for deltagerne, der bliver udfordret i tempuradejens udsøgte sprødhed.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 1137

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 506

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer Impression
programme.desc: In 1987, the death of Crystal Purcell was considered an accident. Then in 2001, Barbara Purcell called police to suggest that her estranged husband had killed Crystal.

programme.title: Forensic Files: If I Were You
programme.desc: Paul Gruber's daughter suspected something was wrong when she received birthday cards addressed from her father, but written in a stranger's handwriting.

programme.title: Forensic Files: As the Tide Turns
programme.desc: The woman was dead. The man had been shot four times and survived. When the man's version of events contradicted physical evidence, investigators turned to forensic science to paint a clearer picture of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Tight Leash
programme.desc: How did the stalker obtain the security system code for his victim's home? How did he steal her personal photographs? Police needed answers and they found them in the most unlikely of places.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muffled Cries
programme.desc: After inspecting storm damage to a home in Tampa, an insurance assessor simply disappeared. Thirty hours later, her body was found in a nearby river. But the killer had been careless.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Critical Maneuver
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run accident claimed the life of a high school athlete, everyone in town mourned his passing. Finding the killer was a long shot at best.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skirting the Evidence
programme.desc: A murder trail turned cold, until police got a call from a woman whose husband, Gerald Powers, had a criminal past and a fondness for Chevy Berettas.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In 1991, Grand Junction, Colorado is on edge after a series of deadly bombings kill two people and injure one more. Police race to find the culprit before he strikes again.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fresh Heir
programme.desc: Lives changed in the 20 years following an unsolved murder, and so did forensic science. In time, a high-powered microscope and DNA profiling revealed a clue no one had seen before.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Missing
programme.desc: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Some are runaways who find their way home, but others simply disappear. When foul play is suspected, investigators turn to forensics to find the missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In The Line of Fire
programme.desc: Bombers, snipers, spree killers: some people don't care who they kill, they just want to hurt innocent people.

programme.title: The New Detectives: For Love Or Money
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When money is the motive, murder can rip at the very foundation of marriage and family.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Left At The Scene
programme.desc: The tiniest residue left at the scene can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Invisible Death
programme.desc: Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Loose Cannon
programme.desc: In the dead of night, a shooter on a rampage rips through a home, leaving a grandmother disfigured, her 24 year old daughter dead, and a two year-old child clinging to life.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: We Kill the Ones We Love
programme.desc: A drive-by shooting leaves Van Terry dead; to crack the case, Lt. Joe Kenda must put his faith… in a burglar.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Murder in a Bottle
programme.desc: Eric Houston is found stabbed to death in a seedy motel, but the ensuing investigation is stymied by a long list of suspects. Lt. Joe Kenda deploys a groundbreaking new technology to catch the killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Shattered
programme.desc: When two teens discover a lifeless body in the street, Lt. Joe Kenda must determine if the killer was a jealous lover or just plain unhinged.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Primal Instinct
programme.desc: When a drunken dispute at a biker bar turns deadly, Kenda must launch a manhunt for a pair of suspects who fled with a small boy in tow.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: On the Case: Race To Judgment
programme.desc: A late-night crash claims the lives of four girls. Texas community is torn apart in the search for justice.

programme.title: On the Case: Identical Evidence
programme.desc: Police discover a treasure trove of evidence after teacher Genai Coleman is found murdered in a parking lot, but detectives still face a challenge that may prevent the case from being solved.

programme.title: On the Case: Darkness After Dawn
programme.desc: After a newlywed is found murdered in her bedroom, a search is launched for the killer that will last for three decades.

programme.title: On the Case: A Hidden Clue
programme.desc: A hidden clue may hold the key to solving the vicious murder of a young woman.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Under New Management
programme.desc: Joe hires outsider Duane Hicks to help Buffalo navigate the future and coach Mikey. Gord and Sean's DC-3 delivery mission to the High Arctic goes awry when blizzard conditions and a broken oil cooler force an emergency landing.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Over Seas
programme.desc: Buffalo has to get a CL-215 water bomber to buyers in Korea. So Justin and Cory fly the plane to Vancouver Harbour, where it will be hoisted onto a cargo ship sailing across the Pacific Ocean to its destination a method of delivery no one has ever tried.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Birthday from Hell
programme.desc: A string of bad luck turns chief pilot Arnie's 66th birthday run into the flight from hell - and threatens to spoil his naughty birthday surprise.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Power Crash
programme.desc: Cory, Chuck and Brian watch as a 5,000-pound power unit smash to the ground, denting the Electra and putting it out of commission. Mikey scrambles to manage the crisis while Joe races to England to try and purchase a backup Electra.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Frozen Four
programme.desc: As Joe fights a Transport Canada claim against the airline, star pilot Justin is tasked with shipping an 8,000lb generator to a remote town. But a controversial decision results in the DC-4 becoming stranded and frozen solid on a High Arctic airstrip.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dark Skies
programme.desc: When Yellowknife and the northern aviation community are rocked by three crashes in the space of a month, Joe places an extra emphasis on safety, which is why he only trusts himself to perform a dangerous-looking DC-3 stunt.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The FBI Declassified: Saving Ethan
programme.desc: FBI agents and analysts take viewers inside a real-life race against the clock to save a 5-year-old boy held hostage by an armed gunman.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The FBI Declassified: The Spies Next Door
programme.desc: Inside one of the Bureau's most important counterintelligence investigations to track Russian operatives living in America and seeking critical secrets.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The FBI Declassified: 20 Days of Terror: The Austin Bomber
programme.desc: The Bureau works side by side with multiple law enforcement agencies to identify, track and catch a serial bomber who killed and maimed random victims in Austin in the spring of 2018.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The FBI Declassified: The Swindling Seductress
programme.desc: A career con woman - whose scams included posing as an heir to a cosmetics dynasty and an employee of a top Hollywood filmmaker -- dupes friends, lovers and acquaintances out of hundreds of thousands of dollars.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The FBI Declassified: Dangerous Journey on the Silk Road
programme.desc: In 2011, the FBI became aware of “Silk Road”, an online black market website where users could buy and sell goods, including illegal drugs, weapons, fake IDs – even murders for hire were offered.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The FBI Declassified: Enemy of the State
programme.desc: 48 Hours is television's most popular true-crime series, investigating shocking cases and compelling real-life dramas with journalistic integrity and cutting-edge style.

programme.title: COPS: Tell It To My Wife
programme.desc: A man arrested on warrants just wants his wife, a vagrant is caught on camera stealing from a liquor store, and officers check on a woman asleep on the side of the road.

programme.title: COPS: Crash Landing
programme.desc: Police have a breakthrough in a burglary case, a man found with drugs in his pants claims the pants are not his, and officers deal with a familiar domestic disturbance call.

programme.title: COPS: The One Dollar Shoe
programme.desc: Officers wrestle with a familiar nuisance to shop owners, a man's lucky dollar lets him down during a traffic stop, and too much whiskey leads to a domestic disturbance call.

programme.title: COPS: Getting Funcky
programme.desc: A cyclist takes flight, police find a woman at the wheel of a stolen truck, and officers roll up on a couple smoking meth while their four-year-old is in the car with them.

programme.title: COPS: Hit and Run
programme.desc: The threat of a tasing is enough to slow a fleeing suspect, a heated argument between girlfriends leads to vehicular assault, and a man with weed in his car has no poker face.

programme.title: COPS: Be Careful What You Ask For
programme.desc: An unstable man in a standoff with officers begs to be shot, a drunk woman is accused of beating her spouse, and unwanted guests occupy the garage of an out-of-town homeowner.

programme.title: COPS: Cats and Dogs

programme.title: COPS: Sittin' in the Dark
programme.desc: A suspect seen fleeing a vehicle refuses to admit he was ever in said vehicle, and police respond to a call that shots were fired.

programme.title: COPS: The Blame Game
programme.desc: An arrested man has a long list of instructions for his "bae," and a driver charged with heroin possession claims he was framed by the passenger in his backseat.

programme.title: COPS: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: A recently released convict leads police on a high-speed chase in a stolen vehicle, and officers respond to a report of a man pulling a knife on his brother.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Murderous Lovers - Anne Bardot
programme.desc: The disturbing missing case in Paris of 4 years old.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Laurence Dromard Case
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want her dead.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
programme.desc: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Evelyne Boucher Case
programme.desc: On December 9th 1987, the naked body of the young Evelyne Boucher is found near Avignon. An unprecedented investigation begins making headlines.

programme.title: Roswell: The Untold Truth
programme.desc: Major Jesse Marcel undersøger et mistænkeligt vrag fundet i 1947, selvom han får at vide, at det er en vejrballon. Dette program vises uden undertekster.

programme.title: Ancient Engineers: Aliens On Earth
programme.desc: Vores evolution kan være påvirket af vores forfædre og deres guder. Vi er ikke alene i universet. Dette program vises uden undertekster.

programme.title: UFO Hunters: UFO Storm
programme.desc: In May of 2008, the UK's Ministry of Defense made decades' worth of classified files on UFOs freely available to the public.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Artillery, "The King of Battle," has shaped history from ancient cannons to today's M777 Howitzer. Host Wil Willis visits Fort Sill, Oklahoma, to witness modern artillery like the M777 and M109 Paladin in action.

programme.title: Secret War: The Mafia Connection
programme.desc: Lucky Luciano, a mafia boss of the 1930s, was in jail in 1942 on charges of running prostitution rings. US intelligence services did a deal with him and he got the Italians to share intelligence on German U boat movements.

programme.title: Secret War: Double Agent Tricycle
programme.desc: Dusan Popov was almost certainly James Bond. Ian Fleming knew all the stories about him. Popov managed to persuade both the Germans and MI6 to keep him in the style of a millionaire businessman while performing a series of missions against the Nazis.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Seizing Power
programme.desc: In 1930s Germany, Hitler capitalizes on economic woes blaming the Weimar Government and Jews. Despite scandals, Nazi rallies gain popularity and emerge as the largest party. Hitler becomes Chancellor in 1933, using the 'Enabling Act' to seize power.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: In Power
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler's secret agenda is to rid Germany of Jews. By 1938, after creating work schemes and rearming, he orchestrates "The Night of Broken Glass," burning 1,000 synagogues and killing 91 Jews, preparing for further aggression.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Shepherds and Butchers
programme.desc: Den blaserte advokat John Weber (Steve Coogan) mangler klienter og får tildelt en tilsyneladende håbløs sag om en forhenværende fængselsbetjent, der koldblodigt har dræbt syv mænd, men som ikke kan komme med nogen forklaring på, hvorfor han gjorde det.

programme.title: All Nighter
programme.desc: En hård forretningsmand (J.K. Simmons) bliver bekymret, da han ikke kan få fat i sin datter (Analeigh Tipton), og beder hendes dovne ekskæreste (Emile Hirsch) om at hjælpe ham med at lede efter hende.

programme.title: A Good Man
programme.desc: Efter en hæderkronet karriere i specialstyrken, træder Alexander ud rampelyset for at leve et stille liv. Men da en af hans lejere rager uklar med en gangster, bliver Alexander trukket ind en krig mellem kinesiske og russiske bander.

programme.title: Abandoned
programme.desc: I 1989 sejler trimaranen Rose-Noelle ud fra Picton i New Zealand med kurs mod øgruppen Tonga med fire mænd om bord. Da en voldsom bølge vender bunden i vejret på båden, ender den lille besætning uden mad, vand og funktionsdygtigt maskinel.

programme.title: Wrong Turn At Tahoe
programme.desc: Joshua, en hårdnakket indsamler for en hensynsløs mafiaboss, lever i en verden fyldt med brutal vold, og han befinder sig pludselig i midten af en magtkamp med en berøgtet narkokonge.

programme.title: Youth
programme.desc: Vennerne Fred og Mick holder ferie på et elegant hotel i Alperne. Fred er pensioneret komponist og dirigent, og Mick arbejder som filminstruktør. Begge nærmer de sig de 80 år og har besluttet at få mest muligt ud af livet, inden det er forbi.

programme.title: Results
programme.desc: To personlige trænere (Cobie Smulders og Guy Pearce) får til opgave at få en nyrig og højst umotiveret kunde (Kevin Corrigan) i form i denne kvikke og sjove komedie om kærlighed og fitness.

programme.title: No Stranger Than Love
programme.desc: Hvad kan være mærkeligere end det hul, der opstår i Lucy Sherringtons stuegulv? Svaret viser sig at være kærlighed.

programme.title: Boomerang: Hot Sex
programme.desc: Crystal fejrer sit nye job med en tur til Paris. Hun var så interesseret i de sociale medier, men finder eventyr og romanik uden sin telefon og bliver en ny, stærk og uafhændig Crystal, der ikke defineres af sine venner.

programme.title: Boomerang: Feels Like Heaven
programme.desc: Efter en religiøs faste i syv dage går David ind i et drømmelignende stadie, hvor han følger heltens rejse or at finde Gud, så han kan få de svar, han søger.

programme.title: Boomerang: End of the Road
programme.desc: Vi forlader sæsonen, mens slænget hænger ud, men ved et nærmere eftersyn, er de ikke de samme som før. Måske er de virkelig vokset fra hinanden.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Reading The Signs
programme.desc: Mary Janes møgfald går viralt og bliver en stor sensation; Sheldon kæmper med at tage sit forhold til Mary Jane til det næste niveau, og Kara tager hjem for at hjælpe med en indviklet familiesag.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Signing Off
programme.desc: Mary Jane Paul har tilsyneladende alt: intelligens, drivkraft, et smukt hjem, en sportsvogn og en masse designersko, men noget mangler i hendes amerikanske drøm - hendes egen familie.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Facing Fears
programme.desc: Mary Jane kommer på hospitalet efter sin ulykke, og familien samles omkring hende. Paul Sr. tager sig af David, og Helen tager sig af Lisa, mens Kara kæmper for Mary Jane på SNC.

programme.title: Twenties: Ain't Nothing Like The Real Thing
programme.desc: Et jordskælv ryster op i pigernes forhold. Marie tager afstand fra Chuck, efter en aften med pornofilm går skævt. Hattie bliver gladere for Ida, efter hun sorterer hendes gamle manuskripter, fordi det fører til nogle dybe samtaler.

programme.title: Twenties: Redemption Song
programme.desc: Hattie lærer en lektie, når hun skal balancere arbejde og familie. Arbejdet sender Nia i kirke for at rydde op efter Zac og overtale basketball-stjernespilleren, Quintrelle, til at skrive kontrakt med studiet.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Djævel i en våd kjole
programme.desc: Alison og Billy finder Brooke død i poolen. Billy tager det hårdt og bliver hjemsøgt af hendes spøgelse.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Livets cyklussing
programme.desc: Michael frier til Kimberly igen, og hun får ham til at fyre Sydney. Men Sydney svarer igen med et sagsanlæg.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Løb, Billy, løb
programme.desc: Hensynsløse Billy bestikker Amanda til at fordoble hans løn, hvis han scorer en ny klient - hvilket han gør ved at stjæle en idé.

programme.title: Melrose Place: De nådesløse
programme.desc: Alison nægter at synke ned på Billys niveau for nye klienter, men ender i mudder - bogstaveligt talt - på en stripklub.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Den brændende sofa
programme.desc: Kimberly har stadig vrangforestillinger som Betsy, da hun antænder sofaen og opsøger Peters hjælp.

programme.title: Wildfire: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Kris og hendes ledsagere opsporer bortløbne heste i skoven, mens familien Ritter vokser følelsesmæssigt.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Track
programme.desc: Kris undersøger væddeløbsbanens skumle underverden, efter at Wildfire får kolik.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Party
programme.desc: Kris gør en uventet, men altafgørende opdagelse om sin fortid, da en gammel ven ankommer.

programme.title: Wildfire: Identity
programme.desc: Da Kris bliver kastet af en hest og kommer til skade, går det op for hende, at en karriere som jockey kan have en høj pris.

programme.title: Elise
programme.desc: Melodrama, udspillet i en mindre dansk by, hvor vi følger tre respektable ægtepar over en tyveårig periode. Der hersker på overfladen et nært venskab mellem familierne, men forbindelserne er langt mere komplicerede end som så.

programme.title: Sønnen Fra Vingården
programme.desc: Konsulen planlægger - sammen med den korrupte borgmester - hvordan han på den snedigste (men også ulovlige) måde kan selv tjene rigtigt mange penge.

programme.title: Bejleren - en jydsk røverhistorie
programme.desc: Sejr og Maren elsker hinanden men kan ikke blive gift så længe herremanden nægter Sejr en fæstegård. Røvere hærger imidlertid egnen, og herremanden lover Sejr en gård, hvis han kan fange dem. Samtidig kommer en mystisk fremmed og anholder om Marens hånd.

programme.title: NCIS: Tusmørke
programme.desc: Gibbs' værste frygt bekræftes, da han erfarer at hans nemesis, den arabiske/israelske dobbeltagent Ari (Rudolf Martin), er tilbage i Washington D.C., sendt for at dræbe ham.

programme.title: NCIS: Dræb Ari, Del I
programme.desc: Imens NCIS-teamet håndterer Kates død, er Gibbs besluttet på at sætte en stopper for Aris (gæstestjerne Rudolf Martin) rædselsregime.

programme.title: NCIS: Dræb Ari, Del II
programme.desc: Ari (gæstestjerne Rudolf Martin) fortsætter med at forårsage ravage mod teamet, da han bruger dets medlemmer i et tankespil med Gibbs.

programme.title: NCIS: Sølvkrig
programme.desc: Gibbs og teamet bliver tilkaldt, da en lige afdød mand bliver fundet i en grav fra Borgerkrigen. Liget er af en savnet oversergent, som, ifølge Ducky, blev levende begravet.

programme.title: NCIS: Skift
programme.desc: Da en underofficer brutalt bliver skudt på en motorvej, opdager Gibbs og teamet, at officeren levede et dobbeltliv.

programme.title: Love Island: All Stars
programme.desc: Forberedelserne til Valentinsdag er i fuld gang, mens pigerne tager afsted, og drengene modtager overraskende beskeder hjemmefra, som vækker følelsesladede øjeblikke i villaen.

programme.title: Love Island: All Stars
programme.desc: Det har været en virkelig uforglemmelig sidste uge i Villaen, og den gode nyhed er, at der er en sidste chance for at indhente alle de eksklusive usete øjeblikke, de ikke kunne presse ind i showet.

programme.title: Love Island: All Stars
programme.desc: Det er aftenen før finalen, og spændingen er på sit højeste, når de tidligere Islandere vender tilbage for at afgøre skæbnen for de tre par, der har fået færrest stemmer fra offentligheden. De tidligere Islandere slutter sig til dem ved bålet.

programme.title: Love Island: All Stars
programme.desc: Det er live-finale med poolparty, genforeninger og tilbageblik på rejsen. De sidste par deler deres oplevelser, før vinderne af Love Island All Stars endelig afsløres.

programme.title: Love Island: All Stars
programme.desc: Dramaet ruller, når en række uforglemmelige eks-Islandere vender tilbage til paradis for endnu en chance for at finde kærligheden.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven

programme.desc: På en surfertur til Costa Rica gør Kristin Brody jaloux ved at kysse med en lokal bartender, Audrina prøver at modstå den tiltrækning, hun føler til Justin, og Stephanie har det svæt i junglen.

programme.title: The Hills: Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Kristin har en åbenhjertig samtale med Brody fordi hun ønsker at give forholdet en ny chance. Heidis mor kommer til LA, i håbet om at de kan forsones. Lo og hendes kæreste fejrer jubilæum og Stephanie begynder at date en ny fyr.

programme.title: The Hills: All Good Things...
programme.desc: Kristin står overfor en vigtig beslutning, som også påvirker Brody. Audrina slår op med Justin. Lo ved ikke, om hun er klar til at tage det næste skridt med sin kæreste og Stephanie tror, at hun endelig har fundet lykken.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Hold Grudges... JK!
programme.desc: Den ikoniske vennegruppe begynder på en frisk, da de vender tilbage til The Hills og ses for første gang i flere år. Der er nye udfordringer, gamle rivaliseringer og romantiske forviklinger da de indser, at fortiden ikke altid er fortiden.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Not My Family
programme.desc: Stephanie prøver at reparere sit forhold til sin bror, Spencer, Mischa konfronterer Perez Hilton, der mobbede hende før i tiden. Gnisten mellem Audrina og Justin ulmer stadig, men Justin har også fået øje på en anden.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: A Legend in His Own Mind
programme.desc: Audrina får en chokerende oplysning om Justin Bobby, der tvinger hende til at genoverveje sine motiver. Bølgerne går højt, da Spencer og Heidi overvejer deres forhold til Brody. Og Brandon Thomas holder et poolparty for sin mor.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop
programme.desc: Audrina konfronterer Justin efter han nægter at have kysset hende. Brody klager over forholdet til sin far, Caitlyn og hans tidligere bedste ven Spencer. Da de forsøger at udvide forretningen, bliver Spencer og Heidees forhold sat på en prøve.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Second Chances
programme.desc: Wendale kræver svar af hans "Den, der slap væk", Emily. Charlies hoved fordrejes, og stranden leverer en ny kærlighedssyg eks.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach
programme.desc: Terror-tabletten chokerer villaen og afslører et stævnemøde. Der er romantik i luften for Grant og kampen begynder.

programme.desc: Nu gælder det for 'Den, der slap væk'-parrene, da de sendes på en romantisk tur. Bringer det dem sammen, eller ender det skidt?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Temptation, Tears and Tantrums
programme.desc: I en chokerende elimination ryger et par hjem, før en ny steg vælter villaen og en vred eks skyller op uden at ville genoptage noget.

programme.desc: Bølgerne går højt mellem Cam og Kwasi, da Kwasi lægger an på Kayla. Asia eksploderer, da hun tror, at nogle folk i huset er falske. Zak må træffe et valg.

programme.title: Are You The One?: I Want You To Want Me
programme.desc: Nutsa er vild med Brett, men det får konsekvenser for hele huset, at Brett ikke kan glemme Cali. Moe bliver presset til at spille spillet, og Lewis afslører sine sande følelser for Asia.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 505
programme.desc: En gammel bjælkehytte på en ø midt i Nordmarka får en større opgradering og bliver tilpasset nye tider.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 506
programme.desc: En gammel fiskemodtagelse på Sandøya skal have en ansigtsløftning, og de vilde kræfter fra Atlanterhavet kommer til at spille en stor rolle.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 507
programme.desc: Denne gang er teamet i gang med en traditionel hytte omgivet af mosegrønt terræn. Gustav bygger en eventyrlig vildmarksspa, mens Ole bygger borde af flere hundrede år gammelt materiale.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 508
programme.desc: En gammel folkehøjskolehytte bliver forvandlet til en familiehytte, og aldrig før har teamet foretaget en så drastisk omlægning af grundplanen.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 509
programme.desc: En gammel gård fra 1800-tallet i Trøndelag skal renoveres og moderniseres men ikke miste sin sjæl og charme. Det betyder, at Ole skal få et stykke nyt træ til at se gammelt ud.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 510
programme.desc: Ole, Gustav og Halvor renoverer hver deres fiskerhytte på Træna i Nordland. Her kommer deres konkurrencegener op til overfladen, da ejerne skal vælge, hvilken fiskerhytte de bedst kan lide.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 1137
programme.desc: Kvartfinalerne skydes i gang med en hæsblæsende holdkonkurrence. Deltagerne skal finde ud af, hvad der betyder mest – er det tid eller råvarer? Mere tid i køkkenet betyder nemlig færre råvarer.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 1138
programme.desc: Dagens menu består af oksekød og en eliminering. Der er meget på spil, når de fire dårligste deltagere fra i går, skal arbejde med forskellige udskæringer af oksekød i både tilberedt og rå version.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 1139
programme.desc: En ting er sikkert: der bliver kamp til stregen, når der dystes om en semifinaleplads i en klassisk Italiensk dessert.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 1140
programme.desc: Deltagerne bliver sat under pres, når butterdejens ukronede konge Julian Elkjær kommer på besøg med en smuk, sirlig og svær ret. Der er kun ét forsøg til at imponere dagens dommerpanel.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: 8 nye kvartfinalister vender hjem til køkkenet, der er ærter og kartofler på menuen. Det gælder om at have styr på sine tilberedninger og tilsmagninger, de 4 bedste går videre til en vinderdag.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1315
programme.desc: TV-kendissen Linse Kessler byder på middag på sin elskede Bryggen, Islands Brygge i København. Her er plads til latter og sang, men med Linses nuværende økonomi er der ikke plads til meget mere.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1316
programme.desc: Politikeren Sikandar Siddique byder sine gæster indenfor til en oplevelse, der giver gæsterne et indblik i sin baggrund, og vi er med når Sikandar åbner op om en yderst svær periode i sit liv.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1301
programme.desc: Realitystjernen Gustav Salinas byder indenfor i sin eksklusive lejlighed. Værten byder på mad fra varme lande, og lukker sine farvestrålende gæster indenfor i sit svære kærlighedsliv.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1302
programme.desc: Jackie Navarro er en af Danmarks største tv-personligheder og influencere, og i aften byder hun indenfor i sin villa nord for København. Snakken går, når Jackie åbner op om både kærlighed og had.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1303
programme.desc: Der bliver budt på en rørende aften, når kendisfrisør Dennis Knudsen byder indenfor i sin luksusvilla i Korsør. Han lover mad på max 20 minutter - men mon det virkelig kan lade sig gøre uden hjælp?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 501
programme.desc: Louise og Jonas fra Viborg drømmer stort, men drømmen falder til jorden med et brag. Eksperterne kommer på ekstraarbejde, før det – forhåbentlig – ender med, at den lille familie flytter ind i drømmehuset.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 502
programme.desc: Anita og Martins to børn har overtaget hjemmet, og der er legetøj overalt. Løsningen er en større bolig, men det er ikke lykkedes parret at finde det rigtige hus. Nu går eksperterne i gang, men det bliver ikke nemt.

programme.desc: A lifelong resident of the tiny town of Lefroy, Tasmania was murdered outside his own home. Robbery appeared to be the motive, but with no suspects, the investigation came to a halt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Step by Step
programme.desc: When a wealthy socialite died after falling down the stairs, witness accounts contradicted evidence. To find out what really happened, investigators employed a physicist and an expert in accident reconstruction.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Blanket of Evidence
programme.desc: In 1997, Kelly Eckart's car was found, with her belongings still in it, after she worked a late shift in Franklin, Indiana. Days later, her body was found in an isolated ravine.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fired-Up
programme.desc: In 1996, Derrick Duehren returned to find his Oregon home burned to the ground. His wife's charred remains were later found in the rubble. Investigators set out to determine if it was an unfortunate accident or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Two in a Million
programme.desc: A millionaire and his family were executed in their own home. For three years, the murders went unsolved. Finally, a 30-year-old box of ammunition and some fluorescent fibers revealed the ultimate betrayal.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sharper Image
programme.desc: When a young girl was found dead, police quickly arrested the most likely suspect. But cutting-edge technology from NASA enabled a forensic odontologist to prove the wrong man was behind bars.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insulated Evidence
programme.desc: It's usually easy to determine how a criminal entered the crime scene. But in this case, it looked as if the killer vanished into thin air ? and perhaps he had.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Hearted
programme.desc: When a young fireman died from what appeared to be serious but undiagnosed heart disease, his family and friends had no proof of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wheel of Misfortune
programme.desc: Casino security cameras tracked a young woman's movements until shortly before she disappeared. She was never seen again, but through the evidence she left behind, she was able to tell investigators what happened to her and who was responsible.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Invisible Death
programme.desc: Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: To Kill Again
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their capture.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Blooded
programme.desc: Time of death is an important consideration in a murder investigation, but when a killer freezes, burns, or grinds his victim, even the most skilled medical examiner would be at a loss about how to calculate it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Error
programme.desc: Accidental deaths, suicides, disappearances, and fires; they're an everyday part of an insurance investigator's life. But cases shouldn't be taken at face value. Forensics has become a tool for exposing insurance fraud.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Primal Instinct
programme.desc: When a drunken dispute at a biker bar turns deadly, Kenda must launch a manhunt for a pair of suspects who fled with a small boy in tow.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Dead Weight
programme.desc: A seemingly random attack leaves Mary Moebus dead, and police flummoxed by a daunting field of suspects. But when Lt Joe Kenda uncovers a cache of new evidence, he realizes someone’s been lying.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood Sisters
programme.desc: The bullet-ridden bodies of two sisters are found in a suburban house that’s littered with mysterious clues. Joe Kenda learns that the two unassuming young mothers shared an explosive secret.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: A Prayer for the Dying
programme.desc: A mother of two is found dead in the most expensive part of Colorado Springs, leaving Lt. Joe Kenda stumped—until he looks into her personal life.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Door No. 12
programme.desc: Neighbors are stunned when close friends Louis Matos and Colleen Johnson are gunned down for no apparent reason. The case kicks into high gear when Lt Joe Kenda locates a panic-stricken eyewitness.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 1: The Solar System
programme.desc: This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: Jenna får rollen som offer i en event om spirituskørsel. Hun kæmper med rollen, mens Jake og Matty kæmper om hendes opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Awkward: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.desc: Da Laceys BFF Ally kommer til byen beslutter de at 'hjælpe' Jenna med at drikke sig stiv. Næste dag har en glemsom Jenna tømmermænd og kæmper med at huske den vilde aften og hvem hun kyssede.

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna er stadig ikke kommet sig over sine forældres separation og føler sig ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøg på at tilgive sig selv søger hun tilflugt fra sine problemer hos de højere magter i den religiøse lejrskole.

programme.title: The Roast of William Shatner
programme.desc: The Roast of William Shatner blev nomineret til en Primetime Emmy Award i 2007. Afsnittet placerer skuespilleren William Shatner i den varme stol, mens Roastmasteren Jason Alexander og en bred vifte af komikere får ham ned med nakken.

programme.title: Another Period: Annulment
programme.desc: Lillian og Beatrices ægteskaber bliver ophævede, og Lillian og Victor skændes over deres skattede 'Butternut-rum'. Beatrice hjælper Albert med at komme sig over sin øksefobi, og Garfield kommer op at toppes med en ny tjener.

programme.title: Another Period: The Prince And The Pauper
programme.desc: Kommandøren inviterer en prins til Bellacourt Manor, hvilket skaber strid rivalisering mellem Lillian og Beatrice. Peepers toppes med prinsens tjener over ordentlig butlerteknik, og Hamishs cellekammerat prøver at lære ham at læse.

programme.title: Another Period: Trial of the Century
programme.desc: Hamish kommer i retten for mordet på Scoops LaPue. Lillian prøver at bruge retssagen til at få opmærksomhed, og Peepers nyder en sidste dag i frihed, før han prøver at tilstå forbrydelsen.

programme.title: Workaholics: Dry Guys
programme.desc: Fyrene vågner i deres totalt hærgede hus efter en nat med en vild fest. De har store tømmermænd og beslutter at være ædru i en uge, men Adam er ikke helt med på idéen.

programme.title: Workaholics: Temp-Tress
programme.desc: Der er en ny lækker vikar hos TelAmericorp. Adam, Anders og Blake har meget svært ved at koncentrere sig i hendes nærvær. Deres selvkontrol bliver sat på prøve.

programme.title: Workaholics: Heist School
programme.desc: Fyrene beslutter, at skatteborgerne har ret til at eje den lokale legeplads dragestatue. De stille den ude foran, hvor den bliver stjålet af nogle high school-elever. Fyrene går undercover for at få den tilbage.

programme.title: Workaholics: 6 Hours Till Hedonism II
programme.desc: Fyrene har planlagt en fed rejse til Thanksgiving, men de finder ud af, at Blake ikke har et gyldigt pas. Det er pludselig ikke så sjovt, når de skal vente i seks timer på at få et nyt eller aflyse deres tur til Hedonism II.

programme.title: Comedy Central Presents: Rachel Feinstein
programme.desc: Rachel Feinstein taler om, hvor svært det er at finde en mand, der ikke er bøsset, og hvad hun mener om porno.

programme.title: Comedy Central Presents: Shane Mauss
programme.desc: Shane Mauss diskuterer hullet i hans numse, hvorfor det er kikset med fræk snak og hans problem med metersystemet.

programme.title: Comedy Central Presents: Mo Mandel
programme.desc: Mo Mandel diskuterer sine aner som en jødisk redneck, sit første besøg på en asiatisk massageklinik og at vågne pissesur.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader kage
programme.desc: Chris siger ja til at hjælpe klassekammeraten Angel med at forbedre sine karakterer, hvis Angel vil hjælpe ham med at fange Chris’ nyeste flamme, Marias, opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Homecoming
programme.desc: Chris er i syvende himmel, da en sød pige, Jenise Huckstable, inviterer ham til Tattaglia Homecoming-festen.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader engelsklæreren
programme.desc: Da Julius og Rochelle hæver mr. Omars husleje, kræver han, at de renoverer lejligheden, og han flytter ind hos Chris’ familie, indtil reparationerne er færdige.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader min mand

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Docs
programme.desc: Da Docs irriterende nye kæreste, Stacy, gør Chris’ liv til et helvede, beslutter Chris sig for at skille parret ad.

programme.title: Turbomodul

programme.title: Turbomodul

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: Vi stifter bekendtskab med den meget mandige mand Micki Lynge, som lærer os at lave leverpostej. I 'Drømme Om At Komme Væk - En By Ved Havet', fantaserer de tre fyre om hvad de skal bruge a-l-l-e de penge til, som blev omtalt i det mystiske brev.

programme.title: Turbomodul

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: Vi skal atter på besøg i den selvstændige sælger Tonni Bondes skur, for at finde ud af "hvad de unge vil ha'… Eller skal gi'". Den forpinte Karsten kommer endnu engang forbi med en ny frygtelig lidelse.

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: Djarvis, med de "allanhelvedes" masse fede forretningsidéer, har igen hittet på noget nyt. Karsten kommer forbi, da han tumler lidt med narkomani og den slags. Fjeder er også forbi for at fortælle en smule om da Per Syv og ham sammen oplevede Thylejren.

programme.title: Turbomodul

programme.title: Turbomodul

programme.title: Turbomodul

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Hvad gør folk, hvis de får valget mellem at beholde en stor gave selv og give en lille en videre – eller omvendt!? Det ser vi på i de her videoer, hvor vi netop leger med at give dem, der hjælper, den mulighed. Det er overraskende, hvad der sker.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: ”Den Gode Gerning” er skudt i gang, og som noget nyt hylder Pelle og René folk, der til dagligt gør en forskel for andre. Det bliver virkelig rørende, da de hjælper brystkræftramte Malene med at sige tak til hendes hjælpsomme veninde Michelle.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Igen tager drengene med deres kamera ud til skønne mennesker, der er noget for andre. Og i den nordjyske by Hals, falder de over en mand, der har en skøn historie fra sin tid som spejder – en historie, der til stadighed får ham til at gøre gode gerninger.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Der går nærmest hjælpemiddelcentral i den i de videoer, der med i dag – to ældre mennesker med rollatorer og Pelle i en rullestol. Det er med andre ord scenarier med folk, der virkelig har brug for hjælp og dermed ekstra rørende, når folk springer til.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Bedst som René og Pelle troede, at det at hjælpe i ”Den Gode Gerning” udelukkende var for ældre mennesker, så kommer de unge på banen. Dagens videoer er fulde af dejlige unge mennesker, der springer til og på skønneste vis giver håb for ungdommen.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Udenom og sågar henover – sådan foregår det, når folk skal passere det løbehjul, som vi har lagt på gaden midt i Århus. Det skaber stor forargelse skaber vores første virale hit. Se også hvordan det går, når vi gentager eksperimentet i Odense.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi fortæller om, hvordan det er, når vi skal finde en kvinde på gaden, som vi kan gøre gravid. Det er en vild, sjov og skør opgave. Vi har også en medvirkende, der virkelig er presset over hendes opgave og så én, der ikke fatter, hvad der ramte ham.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 510

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 601
programme.desc: Halvor, Ole og Gustav tager turen til øen Fårnøtt i Skjeberg, hvor de møder Deborah, Nils og resten af ​​familien – og forvandler en dårligt placeret bjerghytte til et lyst, skandinavisk paradis.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 602
programme.desc: Denne gang går turen til Tannsjøen i Nord-Odal, hvor søstrene Kristine og Mari har overtaget en gammel bjælkehytte. Her udfordres teamet i køkkenkundskaber, og så skal ét soveværelse blive til to.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 603
programme.desc: I den lille havneby Stavern møder vi familien Brekke. Her er udendørsområdet i fokus: en tilgroet have uden sjæl skal omdannes til en grøn oase med plads til både dovne dage i solen og jacuzziaftener.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 604
programme.desc: Familien Pettersen har fundet deres drømmehytte på Arholmen uden for Kragerø. Men den mørke hytte skal forvandles til et lyst og farverigt sommerhus – og udearealet skal blive en legeplads.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: 8 nye kvartfinalister vender hjem til køkkenet, der er ærter og kartofler på menuen. Det gælder om at have styr på sine tilberedninger og tilsmagninger, de 4 bedste går videre til en vinderdag.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: Deltagerne har 60 minutter i køkkenet! Det lyder næsten for godt til at være sandt... så det er det nok også. Hvad der er vigtigst for at fortsætte i kvartfinalen: Tid eller råvarer?

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: Deltagerne skal finde deres indre saucier frem og have styr på temperaturer og konsistenser, når de bliver kastet ud i klassiske franske saucer på denne vinderdag.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: Kongen af Restaurant Babylon kommer på besøg: August Theil. Han har medbragt en særlig råvare, som kaster deltagerne på dybt vand, men heldigvis får de først en masterclass.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: 6 deltagere træder ind i første semifinaleuge med en tallerken i hånden, som får betydning for, hvem og hvad de skal arbejde med. Det par, som klarer sig bedst, kan nyde resten af dagen fra balkonen.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: De to, som serverer det flotteste scotch egg er nemlig direkte videre til i morgen. De 3 andre skal dyste om de sidste to pladser i en æg-citing konkurrence.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1303
programme.desc: Der bliver budt på en rørende aften, når kendisfrisør Dennis Knudsen byder indenfor i sin luksusvilla i Korsør. Han lover mad på max 20 minutter - men mon det virkelig kan lade sig gøre uden hjælp?

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1304
programme.desc: Der er ikke mange ting tilbage på realitystjernen Vivi Bachs krop, der ikke har været forbi en kirurg , men kan Paradise-baben mon diske op med en menu med lige så meget kirurgisk præcision?

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1305
programme.desc: En forsamling af fire vidt forskellige personligheder mødes, når designeren Søren Le Schmidt skal imponere, men ikke alle ved bordet er lige diplomatiske, når de tilkendegiver deres holdninger.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1306

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1307
programme.desc: Det er en højlydt oplevelse på alle måder, når aftenens vært, journalist og podcastvært Ditte Okman, byder indenfor, men det er ikke alle, der lader sig imponere af ekstravagant pynt og dyre råvarer.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1308
programme.desc: Det er ikke alt, der går helt som det skal, når hardliner politikeren, Mette Thiesen inviterer sine gæster på en overraskende menu. Heldigvis kan meget reddes med lidt vand.
