programme.desc: Tina og Danni solgte deres rækkehus i troen på, at de nok hurtigt ville finde det rette hus. Men nej. Parret er superkræsne, og har høje krav. Kan eksperterne skabe det hjem, Tina og Danni drømmer om?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 504
programme.desc: Laura og Jesper og Jespers to børn bor til leje i Humlebæk, og det er de mildest talt trætte af. De mangler plads, have – og de vil også gerne have børn sammen snart. Men to års boligjagt har ikke givet bonus.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 505
programme.desc: Ulla og Kristian bor i en smuk herskabslejlighed på Frederiksberg med deres to børn. Men de ønsker sig mere plads i et børnevenligt kvarter i cykelafstand til indre by. Kan Tobias Edlev-Nielsen finde et hus til dem?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 506
programme.desc: En lille lejebolig i Vanløse og to små børn – det er ikke det bedste match. Lisa og Erling drømmer om et stort hus med stor have. Tobias kommer på hårdt arbejde, for drømmene er en hel del større end budgettet.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 606
programme.desc: Tunø er med sine blot 118 beboere og en sparsom færgeforbindelse til fastlandet en del af det udkantsdanmark, som kan være svært at holde liv i. Det vil Jan og Christina fra Thunø Kro gøre noget ved.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 701
programme.desc: Carsten driver restaurant Karin’s Hjemmelavede i Næstved. Men jobbet som restauratør, er dog noget uvant for den tidligere VVS’er, der ingen erfaring har på området.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 702
programme.desc: I Vejle er stemningen på nulpunktet. Heini og Marianas drøm om et argentinsk spisehus er begyndt at briste. Heini er nedlagt med sygdom, og Mariana kan ikke klare arbejdet i restauranten selv.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 703
programme.desc: Caféen i Aalborg kører slet ikke rundt. En forretning udelukkende baseret på billige deal-gæster, truer med at slå bunden ud af det unge forpagter-pars økonomi.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 704
programme.desc: På Da Carmine har de en vaskeægte napolitansk kok! Men problemet er bare, at han har mistet passionen for at lave ægte italiensk mad.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 705
programme.desc: I de smukkeste omgivelser i Korsør lystskov ligger restaurant Sommerlyst. Stedet er drevet af Jesper og Yvonne, der 4 måneder inde i deres forpagtning, allerede er ved at kaste håndklædet i ringen.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Letter
programme.desc: Sammi finder Snooki og JWOWWs 'anonyme' brev, og denne gang er det for alvor slut mellem Ronnie og hende - i hvert fald indtil videre. I mellemtiden har Mike, Vinny og Pauly deres hænder fulde, da de har gang i fire piger på en aften.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Not So Shore
programme.desc: Det anonyme brev skaber splid mellem pigerne og det kulminerer naturligvis og ender i et klassisk Jersey Shore-slagsmål. Samtidig opdager Snooki en lille hemmelighed om Vinny.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Sleeping with the Enemy
programme.desc: Stemningen i huset er yderst trykket efter pigernes infight og et meget overraskende hook-up chokerer crewet.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: All in the Family
programme.desc: Vinnys onkel Nino kommer på besøg og føler sig straks hjemme. The Situation fortæller Jose at Angelina var sammen med Vinny bag hans ryg.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Dirty Pad
programme.desc: Angelina fortsætter med at komme i clinch med de andre i huset og The Situation får endelig sin hævn foran hendes venner.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Gone, Baby, Gone
programme.desc: The Situation bliver genforenet med sin Canadiske skønhed, og det underholder resten af huset. Og så fortæller Angelina endelig sandheden om hvad hun mener om sine roomies i Jersey Shore huset, hvilket får Snooki til at se rødt.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Look Who's Back
programme.desc: Holly kommer som et pust fra fortiden. Nathan bringer sin indre Peter Andre med på natklub, mens Sophie flirter løs. De bliver begge varme og svedige af forskellige årsager. Går Sam for vidt, efter han slutter fred med Chloe?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Queen Nathan's Birthday
programme.desc: Holly er bekymret for Chloe, men Chloe vil bare give Sam en lærestreg. På Nathans fødselsdag tager de en tur i vildmarken, men hvad siger de lokale til fire mænd i drag? Sophie tager en dragqueen med i seng.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The New Geordie
programme.desc: Slænget vågner i vildmarken og fordyber sig i de lokales liv - med at klippe får og buske. En aften på den lokale stripbar får Abbie et godt råd, og tilbage i Goldie venter der en ny Geordie!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Sam Busts His Hand
programme.desc: Sophie og Alex vågner efter en hed nat. Sophie er henrykt, men Alex tvivler. Nathan ser rødt, efter Alex tager en beslutning. Sam får ondt i hånden og kommer på hospitaler, så Chloe drukner sine sorger i den helt store stil!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Pride Party
programme.desc: Slænget fejrer Pride, som kun geordierne kan med en fed husfest og en overraskende gæst! Sophie ender i tårer, og Chloe er uimponeret over Alex, så hun kaster kartoffelsalat over ham! Abbie og Adam kommer tættere på hinanden.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Gotta Have Faith
programme.desc: Geordierne er på hjemmebane og klar til at skabe mere kaos end nogensinde. Denne gang får de selskab af gamle ansigter, nye ansigter og familie, da de gør sig klar til at male byen rød igen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: De indledende prøver
programme.desc: I denne to timers sæsonpremiere på Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team. 600 kandidater ankommer til Cowboys Stadium til Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders indledende prøver.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Træningslejren
programme.desc: Træningslejren begynder, og mange af de nye kandidater er flyttet til Dallas uden nogen garanti for at klare træningslejren og blive en Dallas Cowboy Cheerleader.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Spagat
programme.desc: Det er kun anden uge, og Kelli og Judy er hurtige til at introducere kandidaterne for holdets særkender. Mange af de nye er aldrig gået i spagat, og deres manglende erfaring fører til skader for nogle piger.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Makeovers
programme.desc: Det er træningslejrens fjerde uge, og de nye hentes ind til deres DCC-makeovers. Under Kelli Finglass' vågne øje giver nye frisurer og makeup pigerne deres DCC-look.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Uge fem
programme.desc: Det er uge fem af træningslejren, og Kelli er syg. DCC's Technical Director Kitty Carter afløser og afholder ugens første træning. Kitty lægger ikke fingrene imellem, da hun konfronterer adskillige piger med deres sjuskede danse.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 2
programme.desc: Consultant Doctor Chris Young meets his first patient of the day, 76-year-old Mavis, who is in a critical condition having been hit by a car. She has potential life-threatening injuries all over her body, so the team work quickly to assess the damage.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 3
programme.desc: Last year, 1 in 7 NHS workers were physically abused and today is no different as much-loved health Care assistant Kerry is physically attacked by a patient she was trying to help.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 4
programme.desc: 70-year-old Fred is blue-lighted in having suffered a serious fall at home. With a shortage of doctors in the department, he’s taken straight for an urgent x-ray after which he’s transferred to the care of Dr Tom Hawthorne.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 5
programme.desc: The flow of patients at Barnsley Casualty is relentless and today staff are put under even more pressure by patients suffering from the effects of drink or drugs but all need the care of doctors and nurses - whatever their issues.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 6
programme.desc: When a key member of staff calls in sick at the last minute, Sister Rachael’s dream of smooth shift disappears. She must manage a department overflowing with patients, struggling with staff shortages, with longer waiting times and no available beds.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Dexter and Nasir
programme.desc: A Chicago art teacher wants to unify her adopted Rottweiler/shepherd’s dual personality. Singer Patti LaBelle is afraid of her guard dog, an aggressive 150-pound South African boerboel.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Calvin, Rudy, and Milo
programme.desc: A ridgeback mix needs help recovering from a car accident that left him with three-legs; a manic Jack Russell chases motorcycles; and a border collie's herding instincts are out of control.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Titan, Candy and Bella
programme.desc: A new puppy has "Young and Restless" soap star Michael Damian's cat cornered, MTV's "Downtown" Julie Brown wants to unspoil her Yorkie, and a 120-pound Rottweiler needs anger management training.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Joe, and Penny, Roxy, Rico, Lou, & Solomon, and Promise
programme.desc: An Australian shepherd is so devoted to his owner that he breaks leashes to be with her; a neurotic beagle makes trouble for a pack of foster dogs; and an Italian mastiff puppy fears riding in cars.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Bodhi, Maggie & Molly, and Bojo

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Sakai battles the 'conjurer of garlic,' a chef who embraces the pungent ingredient as real Italians do. Sakai is further challenged to use live squids in the dishes.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Three years after losing to Iron Chef Chen, the Italian restaurant Sabatini demands a rematch, this time sending in the master chef of their Tokyo restaurant.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Led by Tadamichi Ohta, the chef who defeated Sakai, the Ohta faction invades Kitchen Stadium to uphold traditional Japanese cuisine. Fuji is team Ohta's first contender against Morimoto.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: In honor of the Girls' Festival, Kaga invites a challenger from the ancient city of Kamakura, Motohito Kondo, who was trained in Kyoto and is an expert in both tea and sake.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wheel of Misfortune
programme.desc: Casino security cameras tracked a young woman's movements until shortly before she disappeared. She was never seen again, but through the evidence she left behind, she was able to tell investigators what happened to her and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Quite a Spectacle
programme.desc: It was one of the most unusual cases in forensic history. Investigators had to find a way to solve a murder case using only a squashed tomato found at the crime scene and tiny, pinpoint reflections of light in a photograph.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Transaction Failed
programme.desc: When a dedicated, well-respected teacher disappeared, police had to determine if she'd gone on vacation without telling anyone or if she was the victim of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Day the Music Died
programme.desc: Seattle police had no suspects in the violent murder of grunge singer Mia Zapata. More than a decade passed before evidence collected by a prescient medical examiner could be used by forensic scientists to identify the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sole Survivor
programme.desc: A Michigan State University grad student disappeared and was presumed dead. With the help of a professor of geological sciences, police hoped to get the "dirt" on her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insignificant Others
programme.desc: How unlucky could one man be? His college sweetheart killed herself and fourteen years later, his wife ended her life in a similar way. Investigators had to determine if this was murder or simply a bizarre coincidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Catch 22
programme.desc: In 1996, 54-year-old Gayle Isleib was ambushed in her Manchester, Connecticut driveway and shot to death. Police had to determine whether obsessive love was the motive for her murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Cinderella Story
programme.desc: The victim had been sexually assaulted and stabbed to death on the beach. A pair of men's tennis shoes was discovered near her body. Police were sure that if they found the man who fit the shoes, they would also find the man who committed the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Screen Pass
programme.desc: A 13-year-old girl went missing from her Colorado home. The only evidence the kidnapper left behind was three fingerprints on a window screen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pressed for Crime
programme.desc: Several suspects and conflicting evidence complicated a brutal murder investigation. But the forensics were clear on one thing: the killer knew his victim, and that alone gave investigators a head start.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Error
programme.desc: Accidental deaths, suicides, disappearances, and fires; they're an everyday part of an insurance investigator's life. But cases shouldn't be taken at face value. Forensics has become a tool for exposing insurance fraud.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scent Of The Kill
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bloodlust
programme.desc: For homicide investigators, it's a race against time as they track their deadliest foe: a serial killer for whom killing is the only way to feel alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own "fingerprint", allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Door No. 12
programme.desc: Neighbors are stunned when close friends Louis Matos and Colleen Johnson are gunned down for no apparent reason. The case kicks into high gear when Lt Joe Kenda locates a panic-stricken eyewitness.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Preying on the Innocent
programme.desc: When the son of a prominent politician is murdered in his basement, Lt. Joe Kenda feels pressure from City Hall to solve the case.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Everybody Lies
programme.desc: After church, deacon Robert Walton is beaten to death in a public park. The case heats up when Lt. Kenda and his team revisit an old friend with a secret. Did the religious leader have a dark side?

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Death Grip
programme.desc: When a speeding truck crashes into a residential building, officers find the lifeless body of Michael Faast behind the wheel. But he didn’t die in the wreck – he was shot point-blank in the temple.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Dead On Target
programme.desc: A young father-to-be is shot dead in broad daylight by a single bullet fired from afar. At the crime scene, Kenda recognizes the hallmark of a skilled sniper.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Chance Encounter
programme.desc: When firefighters find Victor Woods stabbed to death in his burning apartment, homicide detective Joe Kenda tracks Colorado's most notorious serial killer.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 1: The Solar System

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 7: The Milky Way
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot
programme.desc: Soviet Luna 3 was the first to use gravity to change course to photograph the dark side of the Moon. NASA Mariner 10 used the technique to swing by Venus to target Mercury. The gravity sling shot maneuver has become a standard for space navigation.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 3: Asteroids
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 6: Fermi paradox
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: How to Colonize the Stars: The Challenge of Interstellar Flight
